name: Proxy Local AI Subscriptions
summary: Run a local Codex or Claude Code subscription behind a durable localhost-only gateway, then optionally connect it to NextClaw.

summaryI18n.en: Run a local Codex or Claude Code subscription behind a durable localhost-only gateway, then optionally connect it to NextClaw.
summaryI18n.zh: 把本机 Codex 或 Claude Code 订阅通过持久托管的 localhost 网关代理成 OpenAI 兼容端点，并可在验证后接入 NextClaw。

description: Install and configure an audited CLIProxyAPI localhost gateway, complete Codex or Claude Code OAuth without exposing tokens, and keep the proxy independently supervised by macOS Homebrew services or Linux systemd. The workflow requires active and enabled service state, a managed restart followed by a real OpenAI Responses reply, and a durable-readiness gate before it can create a tested NextClaw custom provider under a user-selected provider ID. It reuses that ID for NCP validation and rolls back failed first-time creation. This skill is strictly for the current user's local machine; it does not support public exposure, account sharing, resale, quota bypass, or multi-user pools. Windows does not yet have a supported durable-service path.

The workflow requires active and enabled service state, a managed restart followed by a real OpenAI Responses reply, and a durable-readiness gate before it can create a tested NextClaw custom provider under a user-selected provider ID. It reuses that ID for NCP validation and rolls back failed first-time creation. This skill is strictly for the current user's local machine; it does not support public exposure, account sharing, resale, quota bypass, or multi-user pools. Windows does not yet have a supported durable-service path.
descriptionI18n.zh: 安装并配置经过审计的 CLIProxyAPI localhost 网关，在不暴露 token 的前提下完成 Codex 或 Claude Code OAuth，并由 macOS Homebrew services 或 Linux systemd 独立托管。工作流必须证明服务 active、enabled，并在托管重启后再次获得真实 OpenAI Responses 回复，之后才允许用用户选定的 provider id 创建并测试 NextClaw 自定义 provider。后续 NCP 验收复用同一个 id，首次创建失败自动回滚。本 skill 仅供当前用户在本机使用，不支持公网暴露、账号共享、转售、绕过配额或多用户账号池；Windows 暂无受支持的持久服务路径。

author: NextClaw
